title: Schur functions on a rhombic lattice
summary: We extend the study of discrete analytic (DA) Schur functions to rhombic lattices, utilizing suitably defined shift operators. There is a number of important differences with the classical case, including eigenvalues of the backward shift operator. As an application we solve a basic interpolation problem in a weighted Hardy space of DA functions, introducing a discrete counterpart of the Blaschke factor.
